summary: The document outlines a business case and high-level requirements for 'NovaCart', an e-commerce platform for Northfield Retail Group. It defines four core journeys (Registration, Search, Cart/Checkout, Tracking) and establishes business rules for inventory and order management. However, it lacks detailed technical specifications, specific NFR benchmarks for latency (P95), and critical data privacy compliance details (GDPR/CCPA) required for an e-commerce system handling PII and payments.

risk_factors.title: Missing GDPR/CCPA Data Privacy Compliance
risk_factors.description: The document mentions PCI-DSS but completely omits GDPR/CCPA requirements for customer PII (email, mobile, address). There is no mention of data retention policies (beyond order history), right to erasure, or consent management.
risk_factors.mitigation: Add a dedicated Data Privacy section specifying GDPR/CCPA compliance, including data minimization, encryption at rest for PII, and mechanisms for user data deletion requests.

verification.claim: Risk: Missing GDPR/CCPA Data Privacy Compliance — The document mentions PCI-DSS but completely omits GDPR/CCPA requirements for customer PII (email, mobile, address). There is no mention of data retention policies (beyond order history), right to erasure, or consent management.
verification.reason: Grounding verified: matched 16 source keywords in document context.

risk_factors.title: Ambiguous Inventory Synchronization Strategy
risk_factors.description: The document states stock is refreshed 'Twice daily from the internal inventory system via batch API' (Page 3). This creates a high risk of overselling or cart inconsistency under concurrent updates, violating the expected benchmark for cart consistency.
risk_factors.mitigation: Define a real-time or near-real-time inventory sync mechanism (e.g., Webhooks or Event-Driven Architecture) or implement a reservation system during checkout to prevent overselling between batch updates.

verification.claim: Risk: Ambiguous Inventory Synchronization Strategy — The document states stock is refreshed 'Twice daily from the internal inventory system via batch API' (Page 3). This creates a high risk of overselling or cart inconsistency under concurrent updates, violating the expected benchmark for cart consistency.

risk_factors.title: Lack of Specific Latency Benchmarks
risk_factors.description: NFRs specify 'Search results within 2 seconds' and 'checkout transitions within 3 seconds' under 'normal load'. This is vague and does not meet the specific P95 checkout latency < 300ms benchmark expected for high-performance e-commerce. It also lacks definitions for 'normal load'.
risk_factors.mitigation: Define specific P95/P99 latency targets for critical paths (e.g., P95 checkout < 300ms, P95 search < 200ms) and define load parameters (e.g., 5x average daily load) for performance testing.

verification.claim: Risk: Lack of Specific Latency Benchmarks — NFRs specify 'Search results within 2 seconds' and 'checkout transitions within 3 seconds' under 'normal load'. This is vague and does not meet the specific P95 checkout latency < 300ms benchmark expected for high-performance e-commerce. It also lacks definitions for 'normal load'.

risk_factors.title: Incomplete PCI-DSS Scope Definition
risk_factors.description: The document states 'no raw cardholder data may be stored locally' but does not specify the integration method (e.g., iframe, redirect, or API) or how tokenization will be handled. It also lacks details on network segmentation or vulnerability scanning requirements.
risk_factors.mitigation: Specify the PCI-DSS compliance scope (e.g., SAQ A or SAQ D) and detail the integration pattern with the payment gateway to ensure no card data touches the application servers.

conflicts_and_ambiguities.issue: Conflict between 'Real-time order tracking' and 'Batch inventory sync'
conflicts_and_ambiguities.context: Page 2 states 'Real-time order tracking', but Page 3 states stock is refreshed 'Twice daily... via batch API'. If stock changes are not real-time, order status (e.g., 'Out of Stock') may be inaccurate in real-time.
conflicts_and_ambiguities.suggested_resolution: Clarify that order status updates are real-time, but inventory availability checks at cart/checkout time must account for the batch sync delay or use a reservation mechanism.
